title: Cauliflower Dumplings Canadian Style
description: A keto twist on the classic Canadian comfort food, using cauliflower to make dumplings. Delicious and satisfying.
instructions: In a bowl, combine grated cauliflower, coconut flour, and almond milk. Mix well.
In a separate bowl, whisk the egg.
Add the egg to the cauliflower mixture and mix until a dough forms.
Cut the dough into 8 equal pieces.
Roll each piece into a ball and then flatten slightly into a disk shape.
Place the dumplings on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
Dot the top of each dumpling with butter.
Bake for 20-25 minutes, or until the dumplings are golden brown.
While the dumplings are baking, cook Canadian bacon in a pan over medium-high heat until crispy.
Serve the dumplings with Canadian bacon and garnish with parsley.
Enjoy your cauliflower dumplings Canadian style!
